name: comp-305
title: Dismissible Feature Banner
description: A full-width dark bar with a short update message, a Learn more link whose arrow nudges on hover, and a close button that removes the bar from the page.
use: You want to announce a new feature in a skimmable strip that visitors can dismiss.
avoid: Dismissal lives in memory only, so the bar returns on reload; long copy crowds the single row.
a11y: The close button is labelled and icons are hidden, but the link has no custom focus style and dismissal is not remembered. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A full-width dark strip sits across the top of the stage with a faint divider beneath it. Small light text runs in from the left; at the right sit a Learn more link with a small arrow and a faint X.
behaves: Hovering Learn more slides its arrow a little and the X brightens. Pressing the X takes the whole banner away; otherwise nothing moves while it is open.
customise: The message, link target and labels are written into the file; visibility is local state and no props tune it.
weight: light: One strip and a single state flag; nothing animates until hovered.
